correctness.rationale: The explicit parity-split geometric sequence is the unique inverse-Gram row because 6G is uniformly strictly diagonally dominant. Substitution and uv=r verify every recurrence. The exact absolute-linear-cell formula and a four-geometric-tail sum give the nodal Lebesgue constant; polynomial division by Q(r) establishes the claimed rational identity (reproducible symbolic certificate). Reflection and translation make every nodal kernel L1 norm equal; convexity inside each cell gives the global upper bound and the kernel-sign input attains it. Elementary algebra verifies boundaries, scaling, equality and strict contrast monotonicity. The checker passed 144 independent symbolic, rational and finite-cycle assertions; finite checks are not used as proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural 2-periodic mesh family has an exact sharp L∞ stability constant and a nontrivial strict equality classification. The result reverses the stability effect of a single isolated cell perturbation, exhibiting a genuine distinction between local and extensive mesh modulation. Exact contrast dependence and a 5/3 extremal limit provide a useful structural benchmark for spline and finite-element projection stability; it is not a routine bound or arbitrary finite calculation.
